featured_reviews.review_text:
I had ordered customised birthday cakes for my twin daughters inspired by a K-pop group Stray Kids. Since the design involved several theme-specific elements, communicating the exact cake concept took a bit of back-and-forth, so I’d recommend following up with them regularly during the process in case of customised orders.

featured_reviews.name: Aabha
featured_reviews.review_text:
We chose Priyanka to bake the cake for our daughter’s 4th birthday. She was extremely responsive and professional right from the initial contact. I shared some initial ideas, inspiration pics and she provided quotes for each of the options, always asking for details/providing suggestions. We went with Pineapple cake with “Four ever Sweet” theme and Priyanka executed it to perfection. The details on the cake were so beautiful, we didn’t feel like cutting it :). Since the cakes are eggless, we were not sure if the inside will be soft and moist. To our surprise the inside was so moist, soft, creamy and delicious. It’s one of the best tasting cakes I’ve had in a while. All our guests (kids and adults) loved the cake ❤️.
If you’re looking for a custom cake at a reasonable price, I’d highly recommend booking with her. Thank you Priyanka, for baking our daughter’s bday cake!

featured_reviews.name: Owais Yusuf
featured_reviews.review_text: Stepping into Yazdani Bakery in Girgaon is less like visiting a shop and more like entering a living museum of Mumbai’s culinary soul. While the chai, bun maska, and crisp baked bites are legendary for their authentic, time-honored flavors, it is the extraordinary hospitality of the owner, Mr. Cyrus, that defines the experience. His warm welcome and eagerness to share the rich tapestry of the bakery’s heritage—and his own—elevates a simple meal into a profound cultural exchange. To be treated not merely as a customer, but as a honored guest in such a historic setting, makes Yazdani a rare, heartwarming gem in the heart of the city.

featured_reviews.name: Aleno Ringa
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the oldest bakeries in town inside fort area.  Prices are very reasonable for the food that they serve you. Their chai and bun maska are a must try. Something very interesting about this place is that they have no menu rather, they write whatever is available on a blackboard with coloured chalks which I think is very unique and fancy!
Very good service too. You can also see them slice and package their breads and buns as you sip on your chai. They gave me an oats raisin cookies as complementary which was so nice of them.
If you're around fort area, drop in a for a quick Irani chai and some cookies or buns

featured_reviews.name: Mandar Pitale
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing to express my deep disappointment regarding a cake I purchased from your Charni Road outlet for my daughter’s first birthday on 6th December 2025. The order was for a 1.5 KG Almond Nutella Crunchy flavor cake, square shape with butterfly design.

Unfortunately, the quality of the cake was extremely poor and far below expectations:

The cake design and finishing were very disappointing.

The cream color was extremely dark and left stains on our hands for 2–3 days, which indicates poor-quality ingredients.

There were no pieces of almond inside the cake, and the Nutella flavor was completely missing, despite being mentioned during the order.

Overall taste and texture were unacceptable.

This was meant to be a special celebration for my daughter’s first birthday, and the experience turned out to be very embarrassing and stressful in front of our guests due to the poor quality of the cake. It is truly shameful that a reputed brand like Souffle delivered such a product. If you are unable to maintain basic cake standards, such products should not be sold to customers.
